checks.name: smoke-phase-manager
run: python3 scripts/crew/phase_manager.py ci-smoke create --description 'ci smoke' --archetype-mode build --json && python3 scripts/crew/phase_manager.py ci-smoke status --json && python3 scripts/crew/phase_manager.py ci-smoke delete

checks.name: smoke-archetype-detector
run: python3 scripts/crew/archetypes_v11.py detect --prompt 'drop the legacy_id column from orders' --signals '{"reversibility_low": true, "state_complexity_high": true}' --steering | python3 -c "import json, sys; p = json.load(sys.stdin); assert any(m['archetype'] == 'migrate' for m in p['matches']), p; print('archetype detector smoke: OK')"

checks.name: smoke-verdict-schema
run: f="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/wicked-verdict-smoke.json"; printf '%s' '{"verdict": "APPROVE", "reviewer": "ci-runner", "recorded_at": "2026-05-08T10:00:00Z", "score": 0.9, "conditions": [], "findings": []}' > "$f" && python3 scripts/qe/verdict_schema.py "$f"; r=$?; rm -f "$f"; exit $r

checks.name: smoke-hard-gate
run: python3 scripts/crew/phase_manager.py mig-ci-smoke create --description 'ci hard gate' --archetype-mode migrate --json || exit 1; if python3 scripts/crew/phase_manager.py mig-ci-smoke approve --phase cutover --json; then echo 'FAIL: cutover should have refused without confirmation'; exit 1; fi; python3 scripts/crew/phase_manager.py mig-ci-smoke approve --phase cutover --confirmed-by ci-runner --confirmation-evidence ci:smoke --json && python3 scripts/crew/phase_manager.py mig-ci-smoke delete
